title: Molly acceptance evidence index
description: Shape of <evidence>/index.json read by bin/molly-acceptance-gate. The gate also applies rules JSON Schema cannot express; docs/acceptance/README.md lists them with their reason codes.

records.description: One record per manifest subcase. A second record for the same subcase is rejected as DUPLICATE_RECORD.

subcase.description: Subcase id from the manifest, such as M11.6.

mode.description: Must equal the manifest mode for the subcase.

lock_sha256.description: sha256 of the consumer composer.lock the check ran against, or null when no install was involved.

timestamp.description: When the check finished. Must not be earlier than candidate.json built_at.

command.description: The command that produced the evidence and asserted the expected behavior.

duration_s.description: Wall time. Above the manifest timeout_s is rejected as TIMED_OUT.

counts.description: Test counts. Present means the record is test-bearing. Null only for records that ran no tests.

skip_reasons.description: Keys from manifest.not_applicable that explain counts.skipped.

not_applicable.description: Key from manifest.not_applicable. Lets a non-PASS outcome count as N/A. Integrity checks still apply.

path.description: Relative to the evidence directory, laid out as <subcase id>/<manifest evidence name>.

intervention.description: Manual action a person took during the check, or null. Reported, not rejected.

protected_digest_expected.description: Locked digest of the protected tests.

protected_digest_observed.description: Digest observed after the run. Must equal the expected digest.
